notes: Item 19 is present and extensively disclosed. Data covers 2025 calendar year. Franchisor: Amazing Athletes Franchise Systems, LLC. Two affiliate-owned outlets (NY and MA) and 62 reporting franchisee-owners representing 133 of 169 franchised units are included. Tables 1-2 cover affiliate-owned P&L (figures in thousands for Table 1). Tables 3A-3C cover all/multi-unit/single-unit franchisee P&L averages. Tables 4-13 provide performance cohort breakdowns (quartiles/half-tiles) for gross revenue, gross profit, and net income after royalties. Table 14 provides individual owner-level gross revenue data (not extracted as individual records due to volume, but the aggregate/cohort data is captured). Note: Table 3A outlet_count is 62 (owners) per the '# of Owners' field visible in the image. Table 3C shows '39' owners for single-unit and Table 3B shows '23' for multi-unit (23+39=62). The reporting period for all franchisee data is January 1, 2025 to December 31, 2025. All per-owner basis (not per-unit). Affiliate-owned outlet data is per-outlet average. Minor OCR artifacts noted: missing $ in Table 12 Bottom 50% average ($75,678) and missing comma in Table 11 Top 50% average ($257,089).
